name: Ruishishen
body:
The ruishishen are noble, lion-headed humanoids renowned as ancient spirit guardians. Carrying an imposing presence, heavy leonine manes, and deep spiritual resolve, they are stalwart champions against corruption and planar incursions.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Ruishishen possess powerful physical frames and charismatic authority, but lack nimbleness. They gain +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, and -2 Dexterity.
Type: Humanoid (feline). Ruishishen are humanoids with the feline subtype.
Size: Medium. Ruishishen have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. Ruishishen have a base land speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Ruishishen begin play speaking Common. Bonus languages include Celestial, Draconic, Giant, Ignan, and Terran.
Defense Racial Traits
Lion’s Roar (Su): Once per day as a standard action, a ruishishen can unleash a thunderous roar. Enemies within a 30-foot burst must succeed on a Will saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 character level + Charisma modifier) or become shaken for 1d4 rounds. Allies within the burst receive a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws against fear for 1 minute.
Guardian Resilience: Ruishishen gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against fear, curses, and negative energy effects.
Natural Armor: Heavy hides grant ruishishen a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.
Offense and Skill Racial Traits
Bite Attack: A ruishishen gains a primary bite attack that deals 1d6 points of piercing damage (plus Strength modifier).
Imposing Presence: Ruishishen receive a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate and Sense Motive checks.
